proof_scope: ticket-first drift audit, seam contracts, and tau handoff shape — exercised through the real CLI and one live run against real GitHub tickets and git history

claims.proves: the audit labels declared intent and produced work against a registered immutable goal; absence of an expected artifact is reported as MISSING_EXPECTED and forces DRIFTED; a ticket declaring off-goal work yields DECLARED_DRIFT with zero commits present; a commit citing no ticket yields UNTICKETED_WORK; SERVES_GOAL from a ticket requires closed AND attached proof; an unbounded pile of unproven on-criterion tickets exceeds the indirect cap and reads DRIFTED; no registered goal reads NOT_ESTABLISHED and never ON_GOAL; agent_inferred goals are refused at registration; a failed evidence source reads DEGRADED rather than ON_GOAL; AuditContract refuses a verdict contradicting its own findings; goal_hash is canonical over goal content so an edited goal changes identity; the tau handoff uses tau.generic_dag_spec.v1 and not tau.dag_contract.v1; the audit path performs no mutation and git argv contains no mutating verb
claims.does_not_prove: that tau has executed the emitted spec (never run through tau); that the nightly cron has fired (registered 2026-08-02, first run 06:00); that keyword and glob matching classifies real-world work accurately at scale — matching precision is unmeasured; that /ticket's own lookup surface is used (evidence is read via gh issue list); that goals are recallable from /memory (the registry is local JSON)

cases.input: registered monitor-opportunities goal, 4 criteria, 2 real repos, --since 12h
ticket 'Fix DAG reachability in tau compiler' vs a report-and-resume goal, zero commits
on-criterion ticket, open, no attached proof
9 unproven on-criterion tickets plus 1 closed with proof
audit payload with verdict ON_GOAL while findings contain MISSING_EXPECTED
clean findings but sources_ok reports a failed ticket source
emit the tau handoff for a registered goal
static inspection of core, evidence, contracts and cli
assert: zero mutation calls on the audit path
git argv has no mutating verb via AST
CLI writes only under the state registry

coverage_gaps: no tau execution of the emitted spec
cron registered but has never fired
keyword/glob matching precision unmeasured against real-world work
evidence read via gh rather than /ticket lookup
goal registry is local JSON, not /memory-backed, so goals are not recallable
